warning_summary: UAE reportedly passed Israel a warning from a very reliable source that Hamas was preparing a significant and imminent operation that could occur very soon, without an exact date.
evidence_state: Ynet/ידיעות on 2026-09-09 quotes a senior Middle Eastern intelligence source familiar with the covert Israel-UAE relationship who confirms the warning was passed and treated very seriously in Abu Dhabi. The source refuses to identify the delivery method, Israeli recipient, or whether MBZ personally spoke to Netanyahu. UAE MFA separately says relevant intelligence is shared between appropriate government entities when necessary.
gaps: Recover named Israeli recipient, transmission record, UAE intelligence record or authoritative inquiry finding. Do not create a separate accepted event unless it is shown to be distinct from WARN-5/upstream Sinwar warning chain.

warning_summary: Alleged direct leader-level warning that Sinwar was preparing a major operation.
evidence_state: WARN-5 remains Disputed/Medium. New Ynet source materially strengthens the existence of an underlying UAE warning to Israel, but not the MBZ→Netanyahu leg. A separate Emirati source previously confirmed the alleged conversation to Times of Israel; PMO denies it and cites call-log checks; Ron Dermer denies it; a 2026-09-19 UAE official source told The National that security matters are handled through relevant entities rather than at national-leader level; Kan reports MBZ later told William Burns he had warned Netanyahu of a general violent explosion.
gaps: No transcript, call record, released UAE record or inquiry finding. Keep government-level receipt through the alleged leader call unestablished.

warning_summary: Egyptian warning that Hamas intended to make the ground in Gaza tremble.
evidence_state: Canonical WARN-8 already captures Army Radio reporting that Shin Bet presented the Egyptian warning to Netanyahu; Israel Hayom documentary-recovery reporting links a mid-September earthquake message to early MI inquiry documents. Medium confidence remains because underlying Egyptian/Shin Bet records are unpublished and provenance may overlap WARN-15.
gaps: Resolve whether the Egyptian relay, the Sinwar/intermediary earthquake chain, and WARN-15 are one message through parallel channels or distinct warning events.

warning_summary: Warning roughly three days before Oct. 7 that a major escalation / something big was imminent.
evidence_state: Michael McCaul said after a classified U.S. briefing that Egypt warned Israelis roughly three days before the attack while explicitly saying he did not know the recipient level. Later reporting continues to conflict over whether this is the same event as WARN-76 and whether contact was with Netanyahu personally, the PMO, or another Israeli channel.
gaps: Need primary Egyptian, Israeli or U.S. record identifying exact recipient and content. Do not merge with WARN-76 until provenance is resolved.

warning_source: Jordanian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates
warning_summary: Formal diplomatic warning that continued Al-Aqsa violations foreshadowed further escalation.
evidence_state: Primary contemporaneous Jordanian MFA record and Jordan Times copy/receipt reporting already support Accepted/High WARN-112.
gaps: No action; not a Hamas invasion warning.
